glosses: to peek (through a keyhole, gap, etc.)
to look down into (a ravine, etc.)
to peek into (a shop, bookstore, etc.)
to take a quick look at
to peep (through a telescope, microscope, etc.)
to stick out (a scarf from a collar, etc.)
to peek through (sky through a forest canopy, etc.)

exampleTranslations.1: I peeped out through a crack in the wall.
exampleTranslations.3: I saw Mary looking into a show window.
exampleTranslations.5: He was looking through a microscope.
exampleTranslations.6: The neighbor popped his head up over the wall for a moment.
